text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text:
E-Excuse me! Do you have a moment?!
I'm from the editorial department
of the magazine "KAwaii-Girl"—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Curren knows that magazine~!
It's super popular in my class!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, but Curren's super busy.
I have to go to training, and...

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text:
Kh, please... work with me here...!
It's just a quick street snapshot!
Five minutes, just give me five minutes...!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text: A-A goddess!? Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, how adorable.
A simple snapshot won't be enough to capture this charm...!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text:
—A special feature is what you deserve!!
I'll negotiate with the chief editor right away! Just give me a little more time!!!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Could you tag Curren's account
when you post the photo?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehe, just a tiny bit then... okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to the special feature article in this magazine, Curren Chan's
follower count surged drastically.
...Though it did result in her skipping training."
